purpose: Create freeform characters with retained construction, explicit or body-fitted skeletons, reusable skin fields and solved reach/walk performance.

properties.path: target .glb file outside the protected live machine body
properties.recipe: axm.character-recipe/v0.1 with form body; optional explicit rig/animation OR axm.character-performance/v0.1 body-relative fitting and sampled reach/walk

contains: complete character GLB, static or explicitly skinned and animated
material intent and response binding status
sibling creator-source sidecar with exact recipe and compiled geometry
optional fitted landmarks, generated weights, solved clips and decoded sample-target verification

relationships: treats race as body/look structure rather than a character class
lets unusual body families declare their own clothing regions instead of pretending every garment fits every race
keeps an entire character's construction structure available for later reshaping and reuse
compiles declared landmarks and skin fields into reusable rigs and sampled two-bone performance without inferring anatomy
limitations: Rest skeleton uses parent-local translation with identity rotation and scale; animation supports translation and unit quaternion rotation with LINEAR/STEP interpolation.

Bindings support rigid parts, explicit four-influence weights, axis blends and declared segment-distance fields. Performance fits body-relative landmarks and solves disjoint two-bone reach/walk chains; no inferred anatomy, arbitrary rig retargeting, cloth or corrective deformation.
Declared clothing regions are compatibility metadata, not proof that a garment fits without clipping.
Material response intent can be retained even when the current renderer has not earned a response-organ binding receipt.
Visual similarity, character appeal and target-engine gameplay remain separate evidence gates.

Walk support targets are stationary during declared stance phases; verification covers authored samples only. No between-key contact, balance, ground collision or external-engine import guarantee. Root travel must be accumulated by a playback controller when looping.
